Artifact.title: Artifact
Artifact.description: A file in the public artifact store or the private runtime folder, pinned by hash.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: the on-chain commitment that was audited

network.title: Network
network.description: 'local' or 'test' (never mainnet in this build); null if unknown

block.title: Block
block.description: current chain head, read with a short timeout; null if unreachable

ChainInfo.title: ChainInfo
ChainInfo.description: The chain this validator is bound to (from ~/.cadrecover/chain.json) and, if reachable, its head.

drawing_url.title: Drawing Url
drawing_url.description: API path of the drawing PNG

ChallengeOut.title: ChallengeOut
ChallengeOut.description: The PUBLIC challenge record only (names and ranges, never values), plus its lifecycle.

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: the newest commitment for this identity

CriticalFeatureSpec.title: CriticalFeatureSpec
CriticalFeatureSpec.description: A feature checked at every parameter set; missing or misplaced zeroes that set (PRD v2.1).

next_after.title: Next After
next_after.description: pass this as `after` to continue; unchanged when nothing new

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: completed tasks in the rolling window

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: normalised weight from the standings formula over identities in the newest run; failed audits zero it

latest_batch_weight.title: Latest Batch Weight
latest_batch_weight.description: weight the newest batch gave this uid; null if this identity was not in that batch's run

drawing_pass_rate.title: Drawing Pass Rate
drawing_pass_rate.description: share of tasks whose set 0 passed every check

edit_pass_rate.title: Edit Pass Rate
edit_pass_rate.description: share of hidden-edit sets (1-3) that passed every check

identities.title: Identities
identities.description: one per registration; a recycled UID starts fresh

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Q (0..100); null for a validator outage or before evaluation

url.title: Url
url.description: API path of the GLB (served read-only)

ParameterSpec.title: ParameterSpec
ParameterSpec.description: A parameter the miner's build_part(params) must accept, and the range it may be edited over.

readback.title: Readback
readback.description: weights read back from chain (uid -> weight)

mean_quality.title: Mean Quality
mean_quality.description: mean Q over evaluated, non-outage miners (0..100)

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: V_s: the build ran and produced a valid solid

critical_ok.title: Critical Ok
critical_ok.description: C_s: every critical feature present and in place

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: G_s: solid IoU against the reference, 0..1

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: D_s: fraction of dimensions within tolerance, 0..1

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: valid, critical features ok and no failed checks

failed_checks.title: Failed Checks
failed_checks.description: empty while the challenge is active: failed checks name hidden edits and carry true values

values.title: Values
values.description: the parameter values this set was built with; null until the challenge is retired

revealed.title: Revealed
revealed.description: false while the challenge is active (hidden values withheld)

SetResult.title: SetResult
SetResult.description: One scored parameter set: s0 (the drawing's values) or one of three hidden edits.

latest_event_id.title: Latest Event Id
latest_event_id.description: highest event_id in the log (0 when empty)

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: uid -> normalised weight; empty means no update

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.description: every transition, oldest first; commit and reveal stay separate
